name: km-real
description: KM Real - gestão financeira para motoristas de aplicativo (Quilômetro Labs)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:celular: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend -- --host"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start -w backend
scripts.start:celular: npm run build && npm run start:rede -w backend
